column1: # Festival (五輪祭) minigame pictures: text elements to replace.
# Each picture is an 8bpp 512x480 TIM: CLUT (256 entries) at tim_off+0x14,
# pixels at tim_off+0x220, 512 bytes per row. VRAM (512,0), CLUT (512,480).
# 0x18800 = title picture, 0x55000 = rules page (0x91800 = rules page 2 in
# MINITTL2/6). MINITTL5-8 rules pages are byte-identical to MINITTL1-4
# (same pixels, same CLUT): rows r1/r2a/r2b/r3/r4 apply to both files
# (r1 -> MINITTL1+5, r2a/r2b -> 2+6, r3 -> 3+7, r4 -> 4+8). Title pictures
# x,y,w,h: tight box (picture pixels) over the old text incl. outline and
#   shadow. Body rows start right of the numbered circle (num@ in notes).
# fill/outline: 8-bit RGB (r,g,b), or a description for gradients.
# glyph_h: approx glyph height in px (fill only), lines: line count.
# jp: lines joined with |. Full-width digits/letters are written ASCII.
# notes: num@x,y,w,h = numbered circle (1-4) left of the text;
#   icon@ = controller button / d-pad icon drawn as a picture (keep);
#   botan@ = small ボタン ("button") caption under an icon (Japanese,
#   9-12 px; erase or keep); plate@ = grey R1/L1 button plate.
# Generated by work/re/fest/gen_pics.py from picspec.py + overrides.py.
